svg.title: Format
svg.desc: Field: name, Required: yes, Meaning: The name the window shows, and the one you pass to umbra sign-in (matched without regard to case).; Field: domain, Required: yes, Meaning: The site's domain, such as linkedin.com. It covers subdomains, so www.linkedin.com counts.; Field: login, Required: yes, Meaning: The login page the window opens.; Field: cookie, Required: one or both, Meaning: The name of a cookie that exists only while you're signed in. HttpOnly cookies count.; Field: probe, Required: one or both, Meaning: A path on the site that answers 2xx, without a redirect, only while you're signed in.; Field: probeScript, Required: no, Meaning: For a JavaScript app: render probe (or login), then run this async JavaScript body in the page. Return true only after verifying the authenticated session, or false when signed out. Overrides cookie and HTTP-status checks.; Field: keepSession, Required: no, Meaning: true keeps this domain's session-only cookies between runs. Defaults to false.; Field: keepSignedIn, Required: no, Meaning: true visits the site every 10 minutes so its session never sits idle, and implies keepSession. Defaults to false.
